answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a lantern that rotates unpredictably. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest quartz a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the ripple behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1jfzt.
